Skin meshes to an armature with robust automatic weights, then clean them for engines.

Methods: auto (bone heat), proxy (voxel-remeshed manifold proxy gets heat weights, transferred
back - use for non-manifold/AI/kitbashed meshes or when heat fails), envelope, empty (groups only).
auto falls back to proxy when heat weighting leaves verts unweighted.
Cleanup: remove weights < --clean, limit to --limit influences, normalize.
Usage:
  blender -b f.blend -P bind_mesh.py -- --armature RIG --meshes B

Validate a skeleton + its skinned meshes for animation/engine export; optional safe fixes.

Skeleton: applied transforms, single root at origin, zero-length bones, L/R pairs + mirrored
roll, deform count, constraints on deform bones (need baking), profile naming (roblox R15,
unity humanoid, unreal mannequin).
Skin: unweighted verts, >N influences, non-normalized, weights on non-deform/root bones,
groups without bones, L/R weight asymmetry.
Usage:
  blender -b f.blend -P rig_check.py -- --armatur

Rigify pipeline: add + fit metarig, generate control rig, build an engine-ready game skeleton.

Steps (combine freely):
  --add TYPE      add metarig (basic_human | human | basic_quadruped | horse | wolf | cat | bird | shark)
  --fit MESH      scale/center the metarig to the mesh height (joint placement is still yours)
  --no-face       remove the face rig from 'human' (games: use shape keys or a light face rig)
  --generate      generate the control rig from --metarig (or the one just added)

Create a QA_Stress action with extreme poses to review deformation (elbows, knees, shoulders, hips, spine, neck).

Works on Rigify control rigs (poses FK controls, switches IK->FK) and plain/game skeletons
(Rigify DEF/game names, Mixamo, UE, Roblox R15). Character must face -Y, Z up.
Frames: 1 rest | 10 arms raised | 20 elbows 130 + arms forward | 30 hip flex + knee 120 (L)
        | 40 crouch | 50 spine twist + head turn.
Usage:
  blender -b f.blend -P stress_poses.py -- --armature RIG [--save

Methods: quadriflow (clean quads; needs manifold input - auto voxel-remesh first),

Headless-safe sculpt preparation and procedural "sculpt" ops (no Sculpt Mode - it crashes in -b).

Ops run in the order given:
  remesh=SIZE        voxel remesh (uniform topology, fuses parts)   e.g. remesh=0.01
  symmetrize=+X      mirror one side onto the other (+X|-X|+Y|-Y|+Z|-Z)
  multires=LEVELS    add Multires and subdivide (Catmull-Clark) LEVELS times
  inflate=DIST       push surface along normals (m)
  detail=STR,SCALE   noise displacement (organic surface breakup), e.g. detail=0.01,0.0

Everything is ENV_Storm_*; re-running replaces it. Times are in frames of the current scene fps.

      [--at X Y] [--distance 300] [--height 450] [--strength 1.0] [--no-bolt] [--no-sky]
      [--seed 0] [--save out.bl

Rain, snow, dust, ash or embers as a seamlessly looping Geometry Nodes system (no simulation:
deterministic, headless-safe, any frame renders on its own).

Particles live in a world-fixed box that covers what the camera sees (sampled over the frame
range), fall at real speeds along the wind, stop on --ground objects (raycast) and, for rain,
spawn splash crowns at the impact point. All values stay editable on the ENV_Weather_<type>
object's modifier.
Usage:
  blender -b f.blend -P precipitation.p

optional real snow geometry (GN shell) and a vertex-color mask for game engines.

Inserts one ENV_Weather group node in front of every Principled BSDF of the target objects'

Usage: python tools/sync_shared.py [--check]   (--check: exit 1 if any copy is stale)

Heuristic trigger check: do skill descriptions win for prompts they should own?

Scores each prompt against every description (token overlap, IDF weighted) and checks that the
expected skill is in the top 2. A cheap regression guard when editing descriptions; real agents
use richer matching.
Usage: python tools/trigger_check.py

Lint skills against the Agent Skills spec + this repo's token budgets.

Checks: frontmatter (name/description rules, name == dir), SKILL.md <= 500 lines and
token budget, relative links resolve, scripts compile, Blender scripts expose run()
and a Usage docstring, _bpyx copies in sync.
Usage: python tools/validate_skills.py [--strict]   (--strict: warnings fail too)
